title: Crit Racing on 40 mm Tires – GR:ONE Road Build (Part 1)
disclosure: The creator converts his own GR:ONE into a road race setup; the description mentions no sponsorship for the frame.
summary: The owner rebuilds his GR:ONE as a road race bike with deep wheels, 40 mm tires and a 52T ring and races a local crit to test whether an aero gravel frame can double as a road bike.
